annotations.title: Translate an image set into other languages

description: Makes a finished image set in other languages: the same images with only the text on them translated (numbers, units and names kept), for example an amazon.com set for amazon.de and amazon.fr. Each language becomes its own image set. Images with text cost 1 credit each per language (an edit); images without text are copied free. Call with dry_run true first and tell the person the cost; then call without it (spends credits). Returns the new image set ids; follow them with get_image_set. Example: {"image_set_id": "…", "locales": ["de", "fr"], "dry_run": true}

dry_run.description: Only return the cost; nothing is made or spent

locales.description: Image languages to make, e.g. ["de", "fr"] (codes from list_packs imageLanguages)

name: localize_image_set
title: Translate an image set into other languages
